whats-this: Turns the pointer into a question: click anything in the window to see what it is for and the lessons that teach it.
hold: Asks the agent to stop after the step it is on and start no other; press it again to release the hold.
away: Tells the agent you have stepped away: it keeps its questions for your return and carries on with what does not need you.
away-until: The time you expect to be back, which the agent is told.
away-go: Sends the Away signal with the time you gave.
discuss-btn: Lists the rows you have marked to discuss and the notes the agent pinned, and sends the open ones to the agent.
discuss-badge: Marks this row for the agent to talk about in the conversation; click it again to turn the mark off.
discuss-go: Sends the marked row, with your note, to the agent to answer in the conversation.
aside-text: Your question about this row, answered by a copy of the session without interrupting the agent.
aside-go: Asks a copy of the session about this row; the agent itself is not interrupted.
aside-answer: The answer from a copy of the session, which had no tools: it can explain, not check.
aside-escalate: Turns the aside into a Discuss mark, so that the agent itself answers it.
note: A one-line assumption the agent pinned instead of stopping to ask; confirm, correct or dismiss it.
note-confirm: Tells the agent its assumption was right.
note-correct: Tells the agent what to assume instead, in a line of your own.
note-dismiss: Clears the note without an answer.
receipt: Where a signal has got to: Sent, Delivered to the session, and Answered by the agent.
watch-warning: Says whether your signals are reaching this session now, or when they next will.
setup-stale: Says when the garnet-scoping plugin in Claude Code is missing, turned off, of another version, or has the earlier installation beside it.
open-setup: Opens the window with the commands that install and update the garnet-scoping plugin.
back-summary: Counts what came in while you were away, for the agent to take you through.
tog-sessions: Shows or hides the Sessions panel.
tog-desk: Shows or hides the Desk, the session's present state.
tog-trail: Shows or hides the Trail, the session turn by turn.
tog-memory: Shows or hides the Memory panel.
tog-discuss: Shows or hides the Discuss panel.
tog-subagents: Shows or hides the Subagents panel.
pane-sessions: Every Claude Code session on this machine with its live state; click one to open its window.
pane-desk: The session's present state: its plan, what it is doing, what it waits on, and what it has touched.
pane-trail: The session turn by turn: your messages, the agent's actions and answers.
pane-memory: The notes the agent keeps for this project between sessions.
pane-discuss: The rows you marked to discuss and the notes the agent pinned for you.
pane-subagents: The subagents this session started, with their model, effort, actions and reports.
panel-plan: The agent's task list, with the step it is on.
panel-now: What the agent is doing at this moment, by description and target.
panel-waiting: What the session waits on: you, background work, scheduled jobs and wake-ups.
panel-last-word: The agent's most recent message to you.
panel-for-you: The files the agent sent you in this session, newest first; click one to preview it.
panel-touched: The files the agent read and wrote in its current turn.
row: One item the agent did or said; mark it to discuss, or ask an aside about it, from its menu.
turn: One exchange in the Trail: your message and everything the agent did in answer.
compaction: Where the conversation was compacted; open it to read the summary the agent continues from.
show-earlier: Loads the turns before those shown.
to-subagent: Goes to the row of the subagent this action started.
show-in-trail: Goes to the action that started this subagent, in the Trail.
delivery-file: A file the agent sent you; click it to preview it.
file-open: Opens the file in the application your system uses for it.
file-show: Shows the file in the Finder or your file manager.
file-discuss: Marks the file for the agent to talk about.
session-row: One Claude Code session with its live state; click it to open its window.
session-fold: Hides or shows the sessions this session started.
sessions-filter: Lists only the sessions whose title or folder holds what you type.
view-waiting: Lists every session, those waiting for you first.
view-recent: Lists sessions by project, the most recently active first.
view-alphabetical: Lists sessions by project, the projects in alphabetical order.
splitter: Drag it to share the space between the two panels beside it; double-click to restore their sizes.
splitter-board: Drag it to share the window between the board and the other panels; double-click to give the board half again.
board: A shared whiteboard for this session: draw, ask questions in balloons, and ask the agent to review it.
board-canvas: A shared whiteboard for this session: draw, ask questions in balloons, and ask the agent to review it.
board-review: Asks the agent to read the board now and answer what is on it.
board-editing: Ticked while you are still changing the board, so that the agent waits; untick it when you are done.
board-fit: Zooms the board to show everything on it.
board-copy-path: Copies the path of the board's text rendition, for an agent you give it to.
board-side-left: Places the board on the left of the window.
board-side-right: Places the board on the right of the window.
board-side-top: Places the board above the other panels.
board-side-bottom: Places the board below the other panels.
question-typing: Type a question for the agent; it is sent with the board's next Review.
manual-search: Finds lessons by any word in their titles or captions.
manual-all: Every lesson of the manual, by group.

lessons-: Lists the lessons for this panel; click one to play it.
menu-: An action from this row's menu.
board-menu-: An action from the board's menu.
